properties: Static browser/agent inventory; unchanged actor policy and acknowledgements; unknown methods refused before native acquisition; TypeBox admission; request-scoped new-effect authority and runtime recheck; already-started history completion and revision-fenced rollback; effect-accurate recovery classes; evidence never overstates memory acceptance or native acknowledgement
assessment: Finite verb × actor baseline, all existing CLI commands through both actor paths against pre-registry outcomes, browser call inventory and actual service/dispatcher controls
remaining: Separate resource and assistant action catalogs retain their current owners. Fresh service-issued browser confirmation challenges and observation-linked command tracking require later browser/effect integration; no grant API, retry queue or new workflow authoring is introduced.

partialEvidence.review: Merged protocol design is not implementation acceptance. Independent PR review and selected CI remain required.

evidenceDecision: P4 is finite and directly exhaustive; native runtime and storage ordering retain their existing model/consumer obligations. Mutation controls establish sensitivity of every new test, not full domain-validation or observation-delivery proof.

promotion.scope: Migrated browser RPC, agent CLI and browser forge policy only; independent review and CI required.
